items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: He's a beautiful trombone player. He was with me quite a few years before he went, till he went into the service.

ctx.x: Paradise Theater. He's a beautiful trombone player. He was with me quite a few years before he went, till he went into the service. When he came out, I think he joined Duke Ellington cause I was all set.

Then, I had Bernard Flood. He replaces Jimmy Harris. Yeah. Jimmy Harris was also a trumpet player out of Birmingham. He was from Birmingham too. And Bernard Flood, I don't know where, well, he was from out of New York when I met him.

Oh, I see you have Stretch Ridley here. That was during the time when he came out of the Service. I had 5 saxes. So, when he came out of the Service, I hired him to join me then. And, at that time, I had 6 saxophones, three tenors. And I hated to see the boys come out of the Service when they with me before, until they got set, although I was set. So, I just included the whole band. At one time, I went up to about 22 pieces, and I kept that for about, oh, maybe a couple of years cause there were too many men. I…
